column11: ANCHOR, Rezdiffra's first full year by the capture_anchor identity on Madrigal's own patient counts: more than 11,800 on therapy at year-end 2024 and more than 36,250 at year-end 2025 (8-K exhibits 0001193125-25-035787, 0001628280-26-009476). At the 34.18% stopping rate above, 11,800 x 0.6582 = 7,766 carried, so 2025 new starts were 28,484. Rezdiffra's label pool is MASH with F2 or F3 fibrosis: 6.7mm with MASH at F2 or above less 1.147mm with MASH cirrhosis (Le MH et al. 2025) = 5,553,000, of which 5,541,200 were untreated at the start of 2025. Capture: 28,484 / 5,541,200 = 0.514%. The pace is still rising: more than 49,000 on therapy at 30 June 2026 (0001628280-26-050775) puts first-half 2026 starts at 19,591, 39,182 a year, 0.711% of the pool left. MULTIPLE 0.5, A JUDGEMENT: 0.5 x 0.514% = 0.257%. Case for more: a first-in-class oral antifibrotic aimed at F3 and compensated cirrhosis, where Rezdiffra holds no label, and a tablet that can sit beside resmetirom. Case against: two Phase 2a trials, the larger read on a blood biomarker (ELF) with no histology, and a launch around 2034 into a class with Rezdiffra and the FGF21 analogues this book already models (efimosfermin alfa).
